_comment: Page copy for donate.html. Edited through the CMS at /admin. tools/build-pages.js writes these values back into the HTML at deploy time, so the text stays crawlable.
hero__p-1:
Every gift puts a young person from Smyrna on a court, in a
      classroom, and next to an adult who shows up for them.
hero__p-2: Ty's Future Stars Foundation is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. EIN 42-2398737. Your gift is tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
giving-form__p-1: Monthly gifts are what let us commit to a season, not just a week.
sponsorship__p-1: Two ways to back something specific rather than the general fund.
other-ways-to-give__h2-1: Not everything happens on a card.
